notes.title: Armor Girl Simulator - Under development screen
I will say why I decided to release it on Steam.
notes.content:
Hello, nice to meet you all.

I am the developer of this app.
I would like to tell you a little bit about why I wanted to release this app on Steam.

In the past, I had made an app for another platform that used armor parts to dress up women.
This app also had a feature to share the completed female warrior with other users.
In looking at the images shared on this app, I noticed something.
Some of the female warriors had parts that resembled nipples or genitalia.
The platform had to remove these images.
I removed the image. But after that, some users posted similar images.
It was then that I realized
I realized that I should release this app on a platform where more freedom of expression is allowed.

So I decided to release this app on Steam.

This app will allow you to create female warriors with free expression.
You can then share the images with other users.
The images will be 2D, but we think you will like them.

If you are interested in designing a female warrior, please play this app.

Best regards
